title: Chirograph manifest (.chiro.json) 1.0
description: A manifest for a scientific-data deposition: the files it contains, their checksums and sizes, plus provenance. Mirrors DVC's .dir body shape (relpath/md5/size) with an added header block. See docs/chiro-format-spec.md. IMPORTANT: JSON Schema can express the shape of a manifest but not its integrity. It cannot check that size == sum(files[].size), that nfiles == len(files), that relpath values are unique, or that body_hash is the hash of the canonicalised files array. Schema validity is necessary, not sufficient - run `chiro validate` for the rest.

schema.description: Format identifier. The fallback when the filename has been mangled by a repository that dislikes double extensions.

schema_version.description: Format version. A differing major version is a hard error for a reader; a higher minor version is additive.

hash_algorithm.description: Algorithm for body_hash and every files[].md5. md5 is the default (DVC-aligned). 'etag' is reserved but NOT valid in 1.0 - see docs/decisions.md D-04.

provenance_type.description: Which guarantee the manifest offers. 'self-deposited': integrity from source, authoritative. 'observed-download': reproducibility provenance for bytes retrieved at a point in time; NOT authoritative.

record_accession.description: Deposition accession this manifest describes (GSE..., EGAD...).

source_url.description: Base location of the data, and the base against which source_path resolves. Required by convention for observed-download.

created.description: ISO 8601 with an explicit offset. When the manifest was written.

retrieved.description: ISO 8601 with an explicit offset. When the bytes were fetched. Required by convention for observed-download; omit for self-deposited.

generator.description: Tool and version that wrote the file.

size.description: Sum of all files[].size, in bytes.

body_hash.description: Hash of the canonicalised files array (spec §4). NOT equal to a DVC .dir hash - see docs/decisions.md D-01.

relpath.description: Workspace path: where the file is materialised on checkout, relative to the import target. POSIX-separated, relative, NFC-normalised. Unique within a manifest, and the primary sort key.

md5.description: Hash of the file's bytes, per the manifest's hash_algorithm. Named 'md5' for DVC .dir alignment even when the algorithm is sha256. Lowercase hexadecimal only (docs/decisions.md D-18); the exact length is constrained by hash_algorithm in the allOf below.

source_path.description: Deposit/source path: where to fetch the bytes from, relative to source_url. Present only when the deposit layout differs from the workspace layout; if omitted, source_path == relpath.

version_id.description: DVC-compat: cloud-provider version id for versioned buckets.

etag.description: Supplementary and NON-AUTHORITATIVE: the repository's native HTTP/S3 validator as observed. Never the content hash - an S3 multipart etag depends on the part size used at upload and so is not a function of content alone. See docs/decisions.md D-04.

files.description: The body. Sorted by relpath on disk; relpath values are unique.
